text:
zoe: quick sync — I'm prototyping a tiny sampled probe to attribute per-token TTFT vs decode vs kernel time for KV-cache heavy routes. goal: cheap, explainable waterfall we can ship to dashboards + alert on regressions. low noise sampling (1%) and synthetic aggregation.

ajay: sounds useful. what's the expected overhead on p99 and token cost?

zoe: measured on a dev rig: sampling at 1% adds ~0.5% CPU and ~0.2% tail for decode p99 in our microbatch sim. overhead mostly from timestamping and a tiny RPC for sample upload. we should be fine if we guard behind a flag.

leah: do we already emit kernel-level timings today? we have some kernel selector metrics but not token-level attribution split between kernel run, pre/post hooks, and KV cache lookup.

zoe: right — current metrics are coarse. probe will capture: 
- instrument_point = {pre-queue, queue-dequeue, kernel-start, kernel-end, decode-end} 
- labels: {route, model_variant, kernel_name, batch_size_bin, kv_hit=true/false} 
- derived: token_ttft = kernel_start - pre_queue, token_kernel = kernel_end - kernel_start, token_decode = decode_end - kernel_end

ryan: how will we send this to metrics backend? lots of high-cardinality labels.

zoe: plan: local aggregation into sketches/histograms per-route per-minute, then upload 1) compact hist summaries (hdr/tdigest) and 2) small sample of raw events for heatmap debugging. prevailed approach to keep cardinality bounded.

perf-bot: sample run summary (dev cluster): sampled_requests=1200, avg_tokens_per_req=9.3, median_token_ttft=12ms, p95_token_ttft=48ms, median_kernel=6ms

ajay: nice. can we add kernel-fallback tag? a lot of regressions are fallthroughs to slower kernels.

zoe: yes — kernel_decision label includes fallback=true/false and fallback_reason (compat/quantize/kv_miss) as a low-cardinality enum.

leah: dashboard needs: stacked waterfall per-route (median/p95) + delta heatmap comparing baseline to current rollout. also a breakdown by kv_hit=true/false. I can mock panels.

ryan: for alerts: suggest we compute route-level regression score = weighted_delta(p95_ttft, p95_kernel, kv_miss_rate) and alert if > threshold. want to avoid noisy alerts for small routes.

zoe: agreed. we'll multiply by sqrt(route_qps) to downweight tiny routes, and require sustained window (5min).

ajay: about sampling: 1% everywhere might miss fast regressions on low-qps routes. can we do adaptive sampling: min(1%, C / route_qps) so we ensure N samples/min per route?

zoe: good idea. propose: target 20 sampled requests / minute per route up to 5% cap. that covers low-volume but keeps overhead bounded.

leah: for the Prom labels I'd recommend: 
```
metric_name: token_time_histogram
labels: route, model, kernel_name, kv_hit, fallback_type
```
and a companion metric token_time_samples (raw) that we stash for 24h.

zoe: here's the minimal code snippet I'm testing for in-process timestamping:
```python
start = time.monotonic_ns()
# pre-queue timestamp
queue_dequeue = time.monotonic_ns()
kernel_start = time.monotonic_ns()
# run kernel
kernel_end = time.monotonic_ns()
decode_end = time.monotonic_ns()
# push compact event: [route, model, kname, kv_hit, kernel_start-start, kernel_end-kernel_start, decode_end-kernel_end]
```

ryan: can we also correlate with trace_id so ops can jump into full traces when sample flags match?

zoe: yes, attach a sample_trace_id when we keep a raw event; otherwise we send anonymized histogram only.

perf-bot: CI probe run (staging): sampling=2%, sustained overhead=0.7% cpu, upload size=18MB/h for all routes aggregated.

ajay: ok let's do a small rollout: dev->staging(2%) for 24h, then limited prod cohort on 10 high-traffic routes at 1% with adaptive sampling turned on.

leah: I'll spin up dashboard mockups and a compare panel (baseline vs current) by EOD. ryan can you own alert rule draft?

ryan: taking alert drafts. will post PR with query + thresholds.

zoe: action items: 
- zoe: land probe behind flag + config for adaptive sampling (PR queued)
- leah: dashboard mock + example panels (EOD)
- ryan: alert draft PR (tomorrow)
- ajay: run perf baseline on staging 2% and validate overhead (today)

zoe: any objections? :eyes:

ajay: no objections. :thumbsup:

leah: lgtm

ryan: 👍

deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging with feature_flag=token_attr_probe (build: cb3f1a)

zoe: thanks — will follow up with results and sample artifacts in the ticket.
